title: Peach and Apricot Dye
summary: Single-use dye gives compatible equipment a peach and apricot palette.

fields.Use: Combine it with eligible equipment in inventory to recolour it.
fields.Acquisition: Higher-level stock at Helsik or Figaro Pennygood.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
